contexts.text: The Lord's presence with the evil is called absence. AC 6806:2, Explained.
Shade there is absence of light, thus a lack of intelligence and wisdom.
Man is thus in absence from self.
It is unlikeness there that makes absence.
The Lord is then as it were absent, but His absence is not perceived unless it is known from some perception what His presence is.

In proportion as they do not desist from evils the Lord appears to be absent, the degree of His absence is according to the absence of truth and good... hence it is that they who are in Hell are in the Lord's absence.
But still the fact is that the Lord is not absent from man, but man is absent from the Lord.
In proportion as anyone does not know the Lord, the Lord is absent...
All presence and absence there are according to spheres...
The absence of God from man is no more possible than the absence of the sun by heat and light from the earth...
In this state God appears to be absent.
Celestial Spirits never think about absent persons...
